_comment: Static definition of every OSINT / reference source. Live state (health, last success, record counts) is kept in the database. 'adapter' names a module in server/lumon/sources/. A source with adapter null is planned but not implemented. Licence and terms notes were checked against the provider pages listed in docs_url on 2026-10-04; re-check before any redistribution. 'stale_after_hours': how old the last successful download may be before the data is shown as STALE (based on each source's update rhythm).

sources.name: USGS earthquake catalogue (FDSN event service)
sources.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program
sources.coverage: Global; requested for the India operating-area bounding box, last 30 days, magnitude >= 2.5

sources.name: NASA EONET natural events
sources.provider: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
sources.coverage: Global curated events; requested for the India operating-area bounding box, last 60 days

sources.name: GDACS disaster alerts
sources.provider: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (UN / European Commission JRC)
sources.coverage: Global current alerts; filtered to the India operating area
sources.license: Free to use with attribution (GDACS terms)
sources.attribution: GDACS - Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

sources.name: Open-Meteo current weather at major Indian cities
sources.coverage: Up to 40 largest Indian cities from the staged Natural Earth places dataset
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (free tier is for non-commercial use)
sources.evidence_type: INFERRED (numerical weather model analysis, not a station reading)

sources.name: OpenSky Network aircraft state vectors
sources.coverage: Aircraft broadcasting ADS-B/Mode S received by OpenSky receivers, India operating-area bounding box; coverage over India is incomplete
sources.license: OpenSky terms of use: non-profit research/education use, attribution and citation required; any automated or operational use of the REST API (even internal) needs a prior written agreement with OpenSky
sources.update_frequency: Provider: 5-10 s. Lumon: manual refresh only, or bounded automatic polling when OpenSky credentials AND a written agreement are confirmed (see lumon/live_poll.py). India query costs 4 credits: 400 credits/day anonymous, 4,000/day with an API client

sources.name: IODA internet outage events (India, country level)
sources.provider: Internet Outage Detection and Analysis (IODA), Georgia Tech
sources.coverage: Country-level signals for India, last 30 days (no precise location)
sources.license: Copyright Georgia Tech Research Corporation; see IODA terms before redistribution

sources.name: NOAA SWPC planetary K-index
sources.coverage: Global geomagnetic activity index (context, not India-specific)

sources.name: Launch Library 2: launches from Indian launch sites
sources.coverage: Upcoming and recent launches whose pad lies in the India operating area
sources.license: Free tier, rate limited (15 requests/hour); see The Space Devs terms
sources.evidence_type: VERIFIED RECORD (curated launch schedule; dates may be estimates)

sources.name: CelesTrak orbital elements: satellites over India
sources.coverage: Earth-resources, weather and space-station groups; positions computed for the download time, kept when inside the India operating area
sources.license: Free public data; see CelesTrak usage notes (avoid excessive download frequency)
sources.update_frequency: Several times per day (elements); positions computed per refresh
sources.evidence_type: INFERRED (SGP4 propagation of public orbital elements)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS active fire detections (VIIRS)
sources.provider: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System
sources.coverage: India, last 2 days, VIIRS S-NPP near-real-time

sources.name: OurAirports airports (India)
sources.coverage: Large, medium and small airports with iso_country = IN

sources.name: Natural Earth ports
sources.coverage: Major ports inside the India operating area (small-scale dataset)

sources.name: Global Power Plant Database (India)
sources.coverage: Power plants with country = IND; database version 1.3 (last updated 2021)
sources.attribution: Global Energy Observatory, Google, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Enipedia, World Resources Institute (2021). Global Power Plant Database v1.3

sources.name: Natural Earth rivers and lake centrelines
sources.coverage: Rivers touching the India operating area (1:10m scale)

sources.name: Natural Earth lakes and reservoirs
sources.coverage: Lakes and reservoirs in the India operating area (1:10m scale)

sources.name: Natural Earth railways
sources.coverage: Railways touching the India operating area (1:10m scale, generalised)

sources.name: Natural Earth major roads
sources.coverage: Major roads touching the India operating area (1:10m scale, generalised)

sources.name: AIS vessel positions (aisstream.io)
sources.coverage: Vessels broadcasting AIS within a bounding box
sources.license: See aisstream.io terms (free API key required)
sources.notes: NOT CONFIGURED: no AIS feed is connected, so Lumon has no vessel positions (ports are static reference entities, not vessels). aisstream.io needs a free account API key (keep it server-side), a WebSocket client (a new dependency; not added) and a subscription with BoundingBoxes sent within 3 s; limits: 3 connections per account and per IP, no SLA. Pricing is not stated in its documentation. Every adapter must emit the contract in lumon/sources/vessel_contract.py.

sources.name: OpenAQ air quality measurements
sources.license: Varies by originating provider; see OpenAQ terms
sources.notes: Planned. Requires an API key; not implemented in this build.
